value.label: The outcome of a hardship application (e.g. the customer’s hardship application has been declined, and the customer is not satisfied with the offer being made)
Customer requests a written response (we should not proactively ask customers if they want a written response)
Customer is in collections and the complaint relates to collection activity, process or outcome
ANZ's handling of credit information, credit eligibility information or CRB (credit reporting body) (e.g. ANZ agreed to update my credit file and this has not been done)
Responsible lending (e.g. the customer says that their investment loan should never have been provided to them as they did not have the income to support the loan)
Financial advice relating to Wealth products, or by a Financial Planner (e.g. ‘I was provided with poor advice on X product and this has caused me a financial loss’)
Complaints about a third party product, including declined insurance claims i.e. issued by a company other than ANZ (e.g. QBE, Zurich, IOOF)
Serious allegations of fraud/criminal behaviour by ANZ
Customer is represented by a lawyer or consumer advocacy service
Complaint relates to current legal action or poses serious litigation risk for ANZ
